purpose: Videos that simulate YKI task-taking and official test-organizer example pages. Distinguish pedagogical mock from a complete official examination and spring-2027 digital interface.
copyright: Do not download/redistribute YouTube, JYU, Yle materials without rights. Source video/player rights and source-based task keys are unverified.
scoring_disclaimer: The 0–100 scores are editorial match to YKI mock utility, NOT estimated score outcomes or fidelity percentages.

official_2027_policy.claim: OPH states all spring-2027 Finnish YKI tests are digital.
official_2027_policy.unverified: These old official example pages and pre-2027 YouTube videos do not independently verify the final 2027 digital player UI, timing, audio controls or grading. Keep simulator DIGITAL_2027_VERIFIED disabled until evidence is published.

implementation_rules: Distinguish source_type=organizer_demo, timed_section_mock, tutorial_with_examples, exam_overview, background_video_about_exam.
Teacher-vetted source provenance and real player QA are required before content becomes learner-usable in product. Store all sources as external links only.
Refuse to label any pre-2027 video a verified digital 2027 simulation. Only official newly documented behavior enters strict exam fidelity.
Practice video sample answers are exposed through the player and can be sought: record used_sources and prohibit their use in held-out exam mode.
For real exam-like learning: answer independently first, record speaking response outside the embed if consented, then compare with examples; never fake OPH grading.
Some official SOLKI examples link MP3: link to sources, do not copy originals without permission.
Do not borrow third-party copyrighted mock test questions or model answers into first-party original question bank.
